title: Canonical Action Handler Pattern
purpose: Demonstrate a thin action handler under 15 lines with five ordered responsibilities: validate, execute, notify, transition. Actions own no data — they orchestrate Managers and Notifications.
context: A spendResources action that a player triggers to pay for a card. The action validates the player has enough resources, deducts them via the ResourceManager, notifies all players, and transitions to the next state.
before: function spendResources($resourceType, $quantity) { $sql = "SELECT qty FROM resource WHERE player_id = " . $this->getActivePlayerId() . " AND type = '$resourceType'"; $result = self::DbQuery($sql); $row = mysql_fetch_assoc($result); if ($row['qty'] < $quantity) { throw new BgaUserException('Not enough'); } self::DbQuery("UPDATE resource SET qty = qty - $quantity WHERE player_id = " . $this->getActivePlayerId() . " AND type = '$resourceType'"); $this->notifyAllPlayers('resourcesChanged', clienttranslate('${player_name} spends ${qty} ${resource}'), ['player_id' => $this->getActivePlayerId(), 'qty' => $quantity, 'resource' => $resourceType]); return 'nextState'; }
explanation: The action is under 15 lines (ACTN-001). It follows the five ordered responsibilities (ACTN-002): validate (Manager::validateCanSpend), execute (Manager::spend), notify (Notifications::resourcesChanged), and returns a transition string (ACTN-008). There is no SQL (ACTN-010) and no domain logic (ACTN-011). All domain work is delegated to the owning Manager (ACTN-006). The action is registered with #[PossibleAction] (ACTN-009). The transition key 'cardSelected' is semantic (STAT-005). Validation completes before any mutation begins (ACTN-005).
common_mistakes: Exceeding 15 lines by embedding validation or SQL in the action body
Calling notifyAllPlayers directly instead of going through the Notifications class
Returning a generic transition string like 'nextState' instead of a semantic key
Starting mutation before all validation layers pass
Placing orchestration logic in the Manager that coordinates multiple aggregates

annotations.reason: Framework-level validation: arg types are checked by PHP type hints.
Notification sent through centralized class after mutation.
